cases.name: Paula Louise Baxter
cases.about: She was a baton instructor at the San Bruno Parks and Recreation Department and high school majorette. Her supervisor said she was friendly but quiet.
cases.narrative: He stabbed her 4 times and bashed her head in with a piece of concrete. Her nude body was found behind a Millbrae church.
